titulo_da: Det er dyrt; alligevel køber jeg den
titulo_es: It's expensive; still, I buy it.

dog.consejo: He goes with the verb in front of the subject.

investering.consejo: Money that is invested to get something in return.

texto: **Derfor** (for that reason), **imidlertid** (however), **dog** (but yet), **alligevel** (even so) and **desuden** (in addition) go to the beginning of the second sentence. Then the verb goes, and then the subject: **Det er dyrt; derfor køber jeg den ikke.** = It's expensive; so I don't buy it.
Example: **Det er dyrt; alligevel køber jeg den.** = It is expensive; even so, I buy it.
**Men** (but) unites two sentences without changing the order: **Det er dyrt, men jeg køber den.** = It is expensive, but I buy it.
With **dog**, **alligevel** or **imidlertid** the verb goes in front of the subject: **Det er dyrt; dog køber jeg den.** = It is expensive; however, I buy it.

Det er dyrt; alligevel køber jeg den.
Det er dyrt; dog er den god.

Det er billigt; desuden er den god.
